insight: Maker Portola raised $30M within months of the Feb 2025 launch, with Khosla Ventures leading the Series A; 100K+ paid subscribers.
name: Tolan
tagline: A voice-first alien companion app designed for support without engagement-bait mechanics.
description: Tolan is an AI companion app from Portola that matches you with an alien friend from 'Planet Portola' based on a personality interview. You talk by voice, share photos, and build out a virtual planet together; the companion remembers context across conversations. It is deliberately designed against engagement-maximizing patterns — no romance, and nudges toward real-world life. Free to download on iOS with a subscription for full use.
edge: Built against the engagement-bait companion pattern: no romance mode, and it encourages real-world life rather than longer sessions.

references.title: AI companionship app Tolan raises $20M for its virtual alien friend
